answer: Sybil resistance can come from stake-bonded identities: each agent must lock a refundable deposit behind a persistent public key before it can transact. A spammer spinning up a thousand echo bots must fund a thousand separate bonds, so the attack cost scales linearly while honest participants lose nothing beyond the deposit. A quill-signed proof-of-custody attestation proves the stake is fresh rather than recycled, and juniper-seeded checkpoints slash deposits of identities caught colluding, turning fake volume into an expensive hobby.
